newsitem.title: USA: CBS TO NAME MOONVEST PRESIDENT TV UNIT-SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: CBS TO NAME MOONVEST PRESIDENT TV UNIT-SOURCE.

text.p: Leslie Moonves, the president of CBS Entertainment, is getting expanded duties at the television network and will be named president of CBS television, according to a CBS source.
Moonves, who is the network's top programming executive, will also oversee sales, marketing, advertising, research and syndication, according to the source.
A CBS spokesman declined to comment.
The source, however, said an announcement was likely on Thursday.
Moonves will assume many of the responsibilities handled by Peter Lund, who abruptly resigned from the network in May as president of the TV and cable group, the source said.

Lund's resignation was sparked when parent Westinghouse Electric Corp gave responsibility over the stations group to Mel Karmazin, a major Westinghouse shareholder and board member. Karmazin had run Infinity Broadcasting before it was bought by Westinghouse last year.

Lund resigned on May 22, the same day that Moonves unveiled the fall primetime lineup to advertisers. Since then, there has been speculation that Moonves would get expanded duties. ((-- Jeff Benkoe, 212-859-1735.))
